name: FOXO4-DRI
storage: Store at -20 °C, protected from light and moisture.
definition: FOXO4-DRI (F410) is a structurally modified synthetic peptide supplied as white lyophilized powder. The catalogue lists 2 pack sizes: 2 mg, 10 mg. The CAS number, full sequence and molecular weight are recorded in the lot-specific certificate of analysis (COA). Purity is stated at ≥99.0% (HPLC) with white lyophilized powder appearance. Each kit contains 10 vials; minimum order quantity is 1 kit. For laboratory research use only; not for human or veterinary use.

faq.question: How is FOXO4-DRI tested for purity and identity?
faq.answer: FOXO4-DRI is released lot by lot — HPLC for purity (≥99.0% (HPLC)) plus MS for mass — and the F410 certificate lists the measured values alongside the identity entry (CAS 2460055-10-9, formula C228H388N86O64, 5358 Da).

faq.question: How should FOXO4-DRI be stored?
faq.answer: Hold the sealed 10-vial kit at −20 °C, away from light and humidity. Once reconstituted, aliquot and keep at 2–8 °C; this F410 preparation does not tolerate repeated freeze–thaw.

faq.question: What pack sizes are available for FOXO4-DRI?
faq.answer: FOXO4-DRI is stocked in 2 pack sizes (2 mg, 10 mg), 10 vials per kit, MOQ 1 kit. At 1–9 kits the per-kit price is $105.84; 10–49 kits falls to $97.38 (−8%) and 50+ to $89.96 (−15%).

compliance: For Research, Laboratory, and Analytical Use Only. Not for Human or Veterinary Use.
